name: Conzyx
description: Desktop-class AI software engineering IDE for Android: rootless Linux terminal, multi-agent coding teams, GitHub automation, app factory, and cloud hybrid builds.

paragraphs: The complete AI software engineering computer inside your Android device.
Chat with coding agents, edit projects with a desktop-class mobile IDE, execute real Linux commands, leverage AST code intelligence, and run self-healing agent loops — directly on your phone.
features: Mobile Harness unites modern Jetpack Compose UI with a self-contained Ubuntu 20.04 LTS subsystem. It gives you a desktop-class software development environment in your pocket without requiring root access, unlocked…
Structured workflow execution: brainstorm in Plan mode, execute end-to-end in Build mode, or leverage Unified mode with interactive roadmaps, step checklists, and approval gates.
Native integrations with Google Antigravity CLI, Claude Code, and DeepSeek Harness. Guest-aware executable detection, live version refresh, and resumable sessions.
Collapsible Scratchpad and Mode Selector bars toggled on demand via an animated Tune button to maximize conversation viewing area. Continuous media/file attachments even while tasks run.

Multi-tab code editor with persistent tab state across app backgrounding, touch coding toolbar (bracket auto-pairing, indentation, comments), universal Command Palette (Ctrl+P), global regex search & replace, and…

whatItDoes.text: The complete AI software engineering computer inside your Android device.

requirements.text: For Antigravity, select Antigravity CLI in the Agents screen, install it, and tap Sign in with Google.
Mobile Harness starts the official CLI login, opens the freshly generated Google URL in the system browser, and sends the returned one-time code back to that waiting process.
